evidence: Five STM transforms from G0DM0D3 PAPER §3.5 (adapted). hedge_reducer (G0DM0D3 port, 11 patterns): removes I think/perhaps/maybe/I believe/it seems/might be/could be/arguably etc. direct_mode (G0DM0D3 port, 10 patterns): removes Sure,/Of course,/Certainly,/Great question/I'd be happy to etc. spec_mode (WabbleSpec-specific, 5 rules): normalizes modals might->SHOULD, will->SHALL. receipt_mode (WabbleSpec-specific, 8 rules): strips first-person from receipts, capitalizes PASS/FAIL/WARN. casual_mode (G0DM0D3 port, 22 subs): However->But, Utilize->Use, In order to->To; off by default. Polish defaults: hedge_reducer + direct_mode. Clean defaults: receipt_mode + direct_mode. Clean STM scope: receipt artifacts and code comments only — never production code logic. STM receipt field: {stm_applied:[], char_count_before, char_count_after, reduction_pct}.
